items.title: 68004_Howard McGhee oral history interview
items.q: I used to listen to Earl Hines and Fletcher Henderson and all the bands that played in the Grand Terrace.

ctx.x: Well, I liked that. I used to listen to them from Oklahoma City. I could get Chicago on the radio. So I used to listen to Earl Hines and Fletcher Henderson and all the bands that played in the Grand Terrace. I thought about that when I was in the Grand Terrace. I said, "Gee, I used to be so glad to be..."
